host.name: ZnAl2O4 normal-spinel benchmark host
host.file_space_group: P1 (explicit complete cell, not a symmetry expansion recipe)
host.status: Unoptimized constructed host; not author final coordinates and not an exact ICSD export. ICSD 94156 identifies the material family only. The lattice and starting parameter define the benchmark model, not a target geometry.

activator.substitution: Exactly one Al site replaced by Fe in every state; choose and record the site.
activator.concentration_boundary: One Fe among 16 parent octahedral cation sites in a 56-atom model; not an exact representation of experimental 0.5 at.% doping. Final Fe oxidation state is not fixed by the nominal label or initial moment.

states.composition_change: Baseline plus one Zn->Li and one O->F.
UC-2 plus a different remaining Zn->Si.

electronic_boundary.compensation: Neutral-cell electronic compensation in all three states. UC-3 formal ionic bookkeeping sums to +2 (Zn2+, Li+, Si4+, Al3+, Fe3+, O2-, F-); allow electronic redistribution at neutral atom-count electron number, not an added background charge.
electronic_boundary.excluded_changes: Do not add vacancies, counterions, extra antisites or change element counts to impose a different ionic compensation mechanism.
electronic_boundary.magnetism: Use a documented spin-polarized treatment for Fe; declare initial moments and inspect final moments/electronic state. A nominal high-spin Fe initialization is a trial, not a verified oxidation state.

relaxation_boundary.relax: Atomic positions only at the supplied lattice; do not optimize lattice vectors.
relaxation_boundary.method: Choose and report a defensible periodic method, potentials/basis, sampling and electronic/force convergence criteria; test relevant numerical sensitivity.

site_boundary: Li and Si substitute parent tetrahedral Zn sites; Fe substitutes a parent octahedral Al site. F substitutes an anion O site participating in Al/Fe-centered (O,F)6 octahedra; the O site itself is not six-coordinate. Explore relative site choices without a supplied ranking.

geometry_definition.center_ids: Retain host labels through substitution and map them to final file atom indices.
geometry_definition.neighbors: For every cation, sort periodic O/F neighbors by distance (ties by retained atom ID and image). Report nearest four for parent Zn/Li/Si centers and nearest six for Al/Fe centers, plus next-neighbor distance and any changed coordination/topology. This is a nominal-shell extraction, not proof of coordination.
geometry_definition.bonds: Report every selected center-neighbor distance in A with atom IDs and periodic image vectors.
geometry_definition.angles: Report all unordered pairs of selected neighbors around each center in degrees (six angles for a four-member shell, fifteen for a six-member shell). Include both endpoint images. Do not select the angle closest to an expected value.
geometry_definition.comparison: Use complete same-definition sets or explicitly defined mean/range summaries; separate different bond/angle labels and compare matching site classes across states. Do not hide split shells or topology changes.

boundary: Use this self-contained model; no paper/SI, web lookup, final doped coordinates, site ranking or target observables are inputs.
